verses.en: And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus, that all the world should be taxed.
verses.pt: Naqueles dias saiu um decreto da parte de César Augusto, para que todo o mundo fosse recenseado.
verses.en_web: Now in those days, a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be enrolled.
verses.en_bbe: Now it came about in those days that an order went out from Caesar Augustus that there was to be a numbering of all the world.

verses.en: (And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)
verses.pt: Este primeiro recenseamento foi feito quando Quirínio era governador da Síria.
verses.en_web: This was the first enrollment made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.
verses.en_bbe: This was the first numbering, which was made when Quirinius was ruler of Syria.

verses.en: And all went to be taxed, every one into his own city.
verses.pt: E todos iam alistar-se, cada um à sua própria cidade.
verses.en_web: All went to enroll themselves, everyone to his own city.
verses.en_bbe: And all men went to be numbered, everyone to his town.

verses.en: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judaea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)
verses.pt: Subiu também José, da Galiléia, da cidade de Nazaré, à cidade de Davi, chamada Belém, porque era da casa e família de Davi,
verses.en_web: Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, to David’s city, which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and family of David;
verses.en_bbe: And Joseph went up from Galilee, out of the town of Nazareth, into Judaea, to Beth-lehem, the town of David, because he was of the house and family of David,

verses.en: To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child.
verses.pt: a fim de alistar-se com Maria, sua esposa, que estava grávida.
verses.en_web: to enroll himself with Mary, who was pledged to be married to him as wife, being pregnant.
verses.en_bbe: To be put on the list with Mary, his future wife, who was about to become a mother.

verses.en: And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered.
verses.pt: Enquanto estavam ali, chegou o tempo em que ela havia de dar à luz,
verses.en_web: While they were there, the day had come for her to give birth.
verses.en_bbe: And while they were there, the time came for her to give birth.

verses.en: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.
verses.pt: e teve a seu filho primogênito; envolveu-o em faixas e o deitou em uma manjedoura, porque não havia lugar para eles na estalagem.
verses.en_web: She gave birth to her firstborn son. She wrapped him in bands of cloth, and laid him in a feeding trough, because there was no room for them in the inn.
verses.en_bbe: And she had her first son; and folding him in linen, she put him to rest in the place where the cattle had their food, because there was no room for them in the house.

verses.en: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.
verses.pt: Ora, havia naquela mesma região pastores que estavam no campo, e guardavam durante as vigílias da noite o seu rebanho.
verses.en_web: There were shepherds in the same country staying in the field, and keeping watch by night over their flock.
verses.en_bbe: And in the same country there were keepers of sheep in the fields, watching over their flock by night.

verses.en: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.
verses.pt: E um anjo do Senhor apareceu-lhes, e a glória do Senhor os cercou de resplendor; pelo que se encheram de grande temor.
verses.en_web: Behold, an angel of the Lord stood by them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.
verses.en_bbe: And an angel of the Lord came to them, and the glory of the Lord was shining round about them: and fear came on them.

verses.en: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.
verses.pt: O anjo, porém, lhes disse: Não temais, porquanto vos trago novas de grande alegria que o será para todo o povo:
verses.en_web: The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people.
verses.en_bbe: And the angel said, Have no fear; for truly, I give you good news of great joy which will be for all the people:

verses.en: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.
verses.pt: É que vos nasceu hoje, na cidade de Davi, o Salvador, que é Cristo, o Senhor.
verses.en_web: For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.
verses.en_bbe: For on this day, in the town of David, a Saviour has come to birth, who is Christ the Lord.

verses.en: And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.
verses.pt: E isto vos será por sinal: Achareis um menino envolto em faixas, e deitado em uma manjedoura.
verses.en_web: This is the sign to you: you will find a baby wrapped in strips of cloth, lying in a feeding trough.”
verses.en_bbe: And this is the sign to you: you will see a young child folded in linen, in the place where the cattle have their food.

verses.en: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying,
verses.pt: Então, de repente, apareceu junto ao anjo grande multidão da milícia celestial, louvando a Deus e dizendo:
verses.en_web: Suddenly, there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army praising God, and saying,
verses.en_bbe: And suddenly there was with the angel a great band of spirits from heaven, giving praise to God, and saying,

verses.en: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.
verses.pt: Glória a Deus nas maiores alturas, e paz na terra entre os homens de boa vontade.
verses.en_web: “Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”
verses.en_bbe: Glory to God in the highest, and on the earth peace among men with whom he is well pleased.

verses.en: And it came to pass, as the angels were gone away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the Lord hath made known unto us.
verses.pt: E logo que os anjos se retiraram deles para o céu, diziam os pastores uns aos outros: Vamos já até Belém, e vejamos isso que aconteceu e que o Senhor nos deu a conhecer.
verses.en_web: When the angels went away from them into the sky, the shepherds said to one another, “Let’s go to Bethlehem, now, and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.”
verses.en_bbe: And when the angels had gone away from them into heaven, the keepers of the sheep said to one another, Let us go now to Beth-lehem, and see this thing which has come about, which the Lord has made clear to us.

verses.en: And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.
verses.pt: Foram, pois, a toda a pressa, e acharam Maria e José, e o menino deitado na manjedoura;
verses.en_web: They came with haste, and found both Mary and Joseph, and the baby was lying in the feeding trough.
verses.en_bbe: And they came quickly, and saw Mary and Joseph, and the child in the place where the cattle had their food.

verses.en: And when they had seen it, they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child.
verses.pt: e, vendo-o, divulgaram a palavra que acerca do menino lhes fora dita;
verses.en_web: When they saw it, they publicized widely the saying which was spoken to them about this child.
verses.en_bbe: And when they saw it, they gave them an account of the things which had been said to them about the child.

verses.en: And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.
verses.pt: e todos os que a ouviram se admiravam do que os pastores lhes diziam.
verses.en_web: All who heard it wondered at the things which were spoken to them by the shepherds.
verses.en_bbe: And all those to whose ears it came were full of wonder at the things said by the keepers of the sheep.

verses.en: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.
verses.pt: Maria, porém, guardava todas estas coisas, meditando-as em seu coração.
verses.en_web: But Mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.
verses.en_bbe: But Mary kept all these words in her heart, and gave much thought to them.

verses.en: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.
verses.pt: E voltaram os pastores, glorificando e louvando a Deus por tudo o que tinham ouvido e visto, como lhes fora dito.
verses.en_web: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, just as it was told them.
verses.en_bbe: Then the keepers of the sheep went back, giving glory and praise to God for all the things which had come to their ears and which they had seen, as it had been said to them.

verses.en: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called JESUS, which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
verses.pt: Quando se completaram os oito dias para ser circuncidado o menino, foi-lhe dado o nome de Jesus, que pelo anjo lhe fora posto antes de ser concebido.
verses.en_web: When eight days were fulfilled for the circumcision of the child, his name was called Jesus, which was given by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
verses.en_bbe: And when, after eight days, the time came for his circumcision, he was named Jesus, the name which the angel had given to him before his birth.

verses.en: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord;
verses.pt: Terminados os dias da purificação, segundo a lei de Moisés, levaram-no a Jerusalém, para apresentá-lo ao Senhor
verses.en_web: When the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought him up to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord
verses.en_bbe: And when the necessary days for making them clean by the law of Moses had come to an end, they took him to Jerusalem to give him to the Lord

verses.en: (As it is written in the law of the Lord, Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord;)
verses.pt: (conforme está escrito na lei do Senhor: Todo primogênito será consagrado ao Senhor),
verses.en_web: (as it is written in the law of the Lord, “Every male who opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord”),
verses.en_bbe: (As it says in the law of the Lord, Every mother's first male child is to be holy to the Lord),

verses.en: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.
verses.pt: e para oferecerem um sacrifício segundo o disposto na lei do Senhor: um par de rolas, ou dois pombinhos.
verses.en_web: and to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, “A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.”
verses.en_bbe: And to make an offering, as it is ordered in the law of the Lord, of two doves or other young birds.

verses.en: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.
verses.pt: Ora, havia em Jerusalém um homem cujo nome era Simeão; e este homem, justo e temente a Deus, esperava a consolação de Israel; e o Espírito Santo estava sobre ele.
verses.en_web: Behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon. This man was righteous and devout, looking for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was on him.
verses.en_bbe: And there was then in Jerusalem a man whose name was Simeon; and he was an upright man, fearing God and waiting for the comfort of Israel: and the Holy Spirit was on him.

verses.en: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.
verses.pt: E lhe fora revelado pelo Espírito Santo que ele não morreria antes de ver o Cristo do Senhor.
verses.en_web: It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.
verses.en_bbe: And he had knowledge, through the Holy Spirit, that he would not see death till he had seen the Lord's Christ.

verses.en: And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law,
verses.pt: Assim pelo Espírito foi ao templo; e quando os pais trouxeram o menino Jesus, para fazerem por ele segundo o costume da lei,
verses.en_web: He came in the Spirit into the temple. When the parents brought in the child, Jesus, that they might do concerning him according to the custom of the law,
verses.en_bbe: And full of the Spirit he came into the Temple; and when the father and mother came in with the child Jesus, to do with him what was ordered by the law,

verses.en: Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,
verses.pt: Simeão o tomou em seus braços, e louvou a Deus, e disse:
verses.en_web: then he received him into his arms, and blessed God, and said,
verses.en_bbe: Then he took him in his arms and gave praise to God and said,

verses.en: Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:
verses.pt: Agora, Senhor, despedes em paz o teu servo, segundo a tua palavra;
verses.en_web: “Now you are releasing your servant, Master, according to your word, in peace;
verses.en_bbe: Now you are letting your servant go in peace, O Lord, as you have said;

verses.en: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,
verses.pt: pois os meus olhos já viram a tua salvação,
verses.en_web: for my eyes have seen your salvation,
verses.en_bbe: For my eyes have seen your salvation,

verses.en: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people;
verses.pt: a qual tu preparaste ante a face de todos os povos;
verses.en_web: which you have prepared before the face of all peoples;
verses.en_bbe: Which you have made ready before the face of all nations;

verses.en: A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel.
verses.pt: luz para revelação aos gentios, e para glória do teu povo Israel.
verses.en_web: a light for revelation to the nations, and the glory of your people Israel.”
verses.en_bbe: A light of revelation to the Gentiles, and the glory of your people Israel.

verses.en: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him.
verses.pt: Enquanto isso, seu pai e sua mãe se admiravam das coisas que deles se diziam.
verses.en_web: Joseph and his mother were marveling at the things which were spoken concerning him,
verses.en_bbe: And his father and mother were full of wonder at the things which were said about him.

verses.en: And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;
verses.pt: E Simeão os abençoou, e disse a Maria, mãe do menino: Eis que este é posto para queda e para levantamento de muitos em Israel, e para ser alvo de contradição,
verses.en_web: and Simeon blessed them, and said to Mary, his mother, “Behold, this child is set for the falling and the rising of many in Israel, and for a sign which is spoken against.
verses.en_bbe: And Simeon gave them his blessing and said to Mary, his mother, See, this child will be the cause of the downfall and the lifting up of great numbers of people in Israel, and he will be a sign against which hard words will be said;

verses.en: (Yea, a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.
verses.pt: sim, e uma espada traspassará a tua própria alma, para que se manifestem os pensamentos de muitos corações.
verses.en_web: Yes, a sword will pierce through your own soul, that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.”
verses.en_bbe: (And a sword will go through your heart;) so that the secret thoughts of men may come to light.

verses.en: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;
verses.pt: Havia também uma profetisa, Ana, filha de Fanuel, da tribo de Aser. Era já avançada em idade, tendo vivido com o marido sete anos desde a sua virgindade;
verses.en_web: There was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher (she was of a great age, having lived with a husband seven years from her virginity,
verses.en_bbe: And there was one, Anna, a woman prophet, the daughter of Phanuel, of the family of Asher (she was very old, and after seven years of married life

verses.en: And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.
verses.pt: e era viúva, de quase oitenta e quatro anos. Não se afastava do templo, servindo a Deus noite e dia em jejuns e orações.
verses.en_web: and she had been a widow for about eighty-four years), who didn’t depart from the temple, worshiping with fastings and petitions night and day.
verses.en_bbe: She had been a widow for eighty-four years); she was in the Temple at all times, worshipping with prayers and going without food, night and day.

verses.en: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.
verses.pt: Chegando ela na mesma hora, deu graças a Deus, e falou a respeito do menino a todos os que esperavam a redenção de Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: Coming up at that very hour, she gave thanks to the Lord, and spoke of him to all those who were looking for redemption in Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: And coming up at that time, she gave praise to God, talking of him to all those who were waiting for the freeing of Jerusalem.

verses.en: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.
verses.pt: Assim que cumpriram tudo segundo a lei do Senhor, voltaram à Galiléia, para sua cidade de Nazaré.
verses.en_web: When they had accomplished all things that were according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city, Nazareth.
verses.en_bbe: And when they had done all the things which were ordered by the law of the Lord, they went back to Galilee, to Nazareth, the town where they were living.

verses.en: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.
verses.pt: E o menino ia crescendo e fortalecendo-se, ficando cheio de sabedoria; e a graça de Deus estava sobre ele.
verses.en_web: The child was growing, and was becoming strong in spirit, being filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon him.
verses.en_bbe: And the child became tall and strong and full of wisdom, and the grace of God was on him.

verses.en: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.
verses.pt: Ora, seus pais iam todos os anos a Jerusalém, à festa da páscoa.
verses.en_web: His parents went every year to Jerusalem at the feast of the Passover.
verses.en_bbe: And every year his father and mother went to Jerusalem at the feast of the Passover.

verses.en: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.
verses.pt: Quando Jesus completou doze anos, subiram eles segundo o costume da festa;
verses.en_web: When he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the feast,
verses.en_bbe: And when he was twelve years old, they went up, as their way was, to the feast;

verses.en: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it.
verses.pt: e, terminados aqueles dias, ao regressarem, ficou o menino Jesus em Jerusalém sem o saberem seus pais;
verses.en_web: and when they had fulfilled the days, as they were returning, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem. Joseph and his mother didn’t know it,
verses.en_bbe: And when the days of the feast came to an end and they were going back, the boy Jesus was still in Jerusalem, but they had no knowledge of it:

verses.en: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day’s journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.
verses.pt: julgando, porém, que estivesse entre os companheiros de viagem, andaram caminho de um dia, e o procuravam entre os parentes e conhecidos;
verses.en_web: but supposing him to be in the company, they went a day’s journey, and they looked for him among their relatives and acquaintances.
verses.en_bbe: And in the belief that he was with some of their number, they went a day's journey; and after looking for him among their relations and friends,

verses.en: And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him.
verses.pt: e não o achando, voltaram a Jerusalém em busca dele.
verses.en_web: When they didn’t find him, they returned to Jerusalem, looking for him.
verses.en_bbe: And seeing that he was not there, they went back to Jerusalem, to make search for him.

verses.en: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.
verses.pt: E aconteceu que, passados três dias, o acharam no templo, sentado no meio dos doutores, ouvindo-os, e interrogando-os.
verses.en_web: After three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the middle of the teachers, both listening to them, and asking them questions.
verses.en_bbe: And after three days they came across him in the Temple, seated among the wise men, giving ear to their words and putting questions to them.

verses.en: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.
verses.pt: E todos os que o ouviam se admiravam da sua inteligência e das suas respostas.
verses.en_web: All who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.
verses.en_bbe: And all to whose ears it came were full of wonder at his knowledge and the answers which he gave.

verses.en: And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said unto him, Son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.
verses.pt: Quando o viram, ficaram maravilhados, e disse-lhe sua mãe: Filho, por que procedeste assim para conosco? Eis que teu pai e eu ansiosos te procurávamos.
verses.en_web: When they saw him, they were astonished, and his mother said to him, “Son, why have you treated us this way? Behold, your father and I were anxiously looking for you.”
verses.en_bbe: And when they saw him they were surprised, and his mother said to him, Son, why have you done this to us? see, your father and I have been looking for you with sorrow.

verses.en: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father’s business?
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhes ele: Por que me procuráveis? Não sabíeis que eu devia estar na casa de meu Pai?
verses.en_web: He said to them, “Why were you looking for me? Didn’t you know that I must be in my Father’s house?”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them, Why were you looking for me? was it not clear to you that my right place was in my Father's house?

verses.en: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.
verses.pt: Eles, porém, não entenderam as palavras que lhes dissera.
verses.en_web: They didn’t understand the saying which he spoke to them.
verses.en_bbe: And his words seemed strange to them.

verses.en: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
verses.pt: Então, descendo com eles, foi para Nazaré, e era-lhes sujeito. E sua mãe guardava todas estas coisas em seu coração.
verses.en_web: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth. He was subject to them, and his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
verses.en_bbe: And he went down with them and came to Nazareth; and did as he was ordered: and his mother kept all these words in her heart.

verses.en: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.
verses.pt: E crescia Jesus em sabedoria, em estatura e em graça diante de Deus e dos homens.
verses.en_web: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus was increasing in wisdom and in years, and in grace before God and men.
